snippet.title: Sobakistan: The Land of Dogs (Video game, Trailer, 2026)
snippet.description:
Wishlist now! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3742720/Sobakistan_The_Land_of_Dogs

Welcome to Sobakistan, a closed-off totalitarian dog-state rehearsing its leader’s funeral. Sobakistan - the land of dogs, is a darkly satirical narrative immersion in a closed off totalitarian dog-state. Be happy and complacent, or else. Based on the same-named comic book by Vitalii Terletckii and Katya.
